Commentary.Commentary: Once again it was James Anderson who was the star with the ball for England. He claimed his 23rd Test fifer but was not supported enough from the other end. The English team has its back to the wall now and will have to bat really well to keep themselves in this Test match. Do join us in a short while for their reply.

The West Indian bowlers did a tremendous job on day one to bundle out the hosts and all they needed was their batsmen to stand up and deliver the goods. The start though was shaky as they were stuttering at 35 for 3. Something unexpected happened after that. Two young men, Kraigg Brathwaite and Shai Hope joined forces to take the West Indian ship out of troubled waters. The pair raised a double century partnership to wipe out the deficit and then some handy lower order contributions saw them gain a 169-run lead.
A lionhearted batting show by West Indies! They have done the unthinkable. Who would have thought after the first Test that they can bat so well and take a first innings lead! Take a bow, Windies!

OUT! England finally get the last wicket! Gabriel is pinged in front! Stokes bowls a length delivery on off, jags back in a touch. Gabriel tries to defend but misses and is hit on the front pad. The English players go up in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shannon walks down to his partner and after a chat he decides to review it. It is a review in hope as it looks out. The replays show there is no bat involved. Also the impact is in line and it is clipping the leg stump. The on-field decision stays. The handy last wicket partnership has been broken. That will also be LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Shannon Gabriel has been given LBW and he reviews it.
Slower ball outside off, Gabriel tries to defend it but gets beaten.

NOT OUT! Gabriel survives! Stokes bangs in a short one on off, Gabriel tries to fend at it but it goes off something to Malan at gully who takes it and appeals. The umpire gives it out and Shannon reviews straightaway. Replays show that the ball had hit the shoulder and not the glove or the bat. The on-field decision has to be overturned.
Gabriel has been given out caught at gully and he has reviewed straightaway.
Gabriel moves his front leg out of the way expecting a bouncer. Stokes bowls it a tad full and Shannon adjusts well to defend it.
A bouncer again! Shannon ducks under it.
Back of a length on off, Gabriel defends it solidly.
Lunch is delayed. We move into the extra half an hour as West Indies are 9 down.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR BYES! Angles it down the leg side, Roach misses the flick and Jonny also fails to collect it. The ball races down to fine leg for a boundary. The lead is up to 169 now.
Back of a length on off, Roach defends it off the back foot.
Fuller in length outside off, Kemar drives it to covers.
Shorter in length around middle, Roach ducks under it.
Bowls a yorker on middle. Gabriel does well to dig it out.
Slower one on off, Gabriel defends it solidly.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower ball outside off, SG tries to go big but misses it completely.
Lands it on a length around off, Gabriel defends it off the front foot.
An off-pace delivery outside off, Shannon goes for the heave but misses again.
A slower ball outside off, Gabriel tries to heave it across the line but does not connect.
WIDE! They are persisting with the short ball. Stokes bangs it short. Gabriel does well to evade it. The umpire signals a wide.
Shorter one aimed at the ribs of the batsman. Roach ducks under it.
Back of a length on off, Roach is solid in defense.
Length outside off, Roach is in no mood to play at it.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Shorter in length on middle, Roach fends it away to square leg for a run.
Wide of the crease, angles it on a length on off. Roach defends it towards mid off.
Another short one. Gabriel ducks under it.
Fuller in length this time, Shannon hits it up in the air towards mid off. The ball falls in no man's land. The fielder from mid on gives it a chase and the batsmen run two.
Shorter in length on middle, Shannon moves out of the way.
Short and wide outside off, Gabriel tries to cut but gets beaten.
Bouncer on middle, SG ducks under it.
Shorter in length on the body, Roach plays it awkwardly to point.
Ben Stokes is now into the attack. Can he take the last wicket?
Length outside off, Roach is in no mood to play at it.
Bangs in a bouncer on off, Roach does well to evade it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Roach defends it off the back foot.
Fuller in length on off, Shannon drives it towards mid on for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, Gabriel tucks it towards mid-wicket.

Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags his length outside off, Gabriel plays it towards point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! BANG! Gabriel can play shots too. Floats it on middle, Shannon lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Roach nails the sweep shot to deep square leg for a run.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, on middle, Gabriel taps it down on the leg side and Stoneman dives to his right from forward short leg to stop the ball.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Gets off the mark in an unorthodox way! A well-directed short ball, around off, Roach tries moving out of the way but it takes the top half of the bat and rolls wide of the point fielder. They cross.
Serves it on a length around off, it's pushed with an angled bat to point by Roach.
Lands it full and around off this time, Kemar lunges and defends it to covers.

Ali tosses it up on off, Gabriel tries to defend it but it takes the inside edge and goes quickly to short leg who drops it. The English side needs to be hanging onto these catches.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Shannon Gabriel is the next man in.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! Needless from Blackwood, falls one short of his fifty. There was never a third run there. Quicker outside off, turning back in. Roach gets beaten on the defence and the ball brushes his pads before going past the keeper. Stokes gives it a chase and stops the ball near the fine leg fence. They complete two and Blackwood attempts for the third one. Stokes fires in a rocket throw to the keeper who collects and whips the bails off. They appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that the batsman was well short of his crease. Blackwood in order to retain strike has lost his wicket. He was dropped earlier and added vital runs after that. The Windies are nine down now.
There is an appeal for a run out at the striker's end. The umpires have taken it upstairs.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Flatter on off, turning back in. Roach tries to defend it but misses and is hit on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Bowls it outside off, Blackwood opts not to play at it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Kemar Roach is the next man in.

OUT! You live by the sword and you die by it! A breezy knock by the Windies skipper comes to an end. Fuller in length on off, Holder moves his front leg out of the way and tries to go big but mistimes his lofted shot. Moeen Ali from mid off runs backwards and takes a good catch. He dropped an easier one earlier (of Blackwood) but made this tough catch look easy. Woakes gets his first wicket. Windies lead by 146 runs.
Fullish length on off, Holder drives it to covers.

The man at deep extra cover comes into play. Fuller outside off, Blackwood drives it to the fielder and takes a run.
Quicker on the stumps, Holder camps back and defends it.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Comes dancing down the track and tries to hit the flighted ball over mid on. The ball turns and takes the inner half and goes towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on off, Holder pushes it to covers.
Tosses it up on off, Holder drives it to covers.
Two in a row! Length outside off, bounces a little more than Blackwood expected. He tries to force it through the off side but gets beaten.
BEATEN! Length ball, outside off. JB pokes at it and gets beaten.
WIDE! Full and very wide outside off, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper. The umpire signals a wide.
A deep extra cover in place.
That was very nicely played! Good length around off, Holder plays it with an angled bat down to third man for a run. It also brings up the 400 up for West Indies.
Good length delivery on off, Holder defends it solidly.

Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Tosses it up on off, Blackwood defends it off the front foot.
Starts off with a flatter delivery on off, turning back into the batsman. Blackwood tries to tickle it fine but misses. The ball clips the pads and goes fine for two leg byes.
Moeen Ali to have a bowl after the break.

Time for Drinks. We are done with an absolutely exciting first hour of Day 3. It began with a couple of wickets but since then the current partnership has flourished and kept England at bay. The lead keeps on growing and is nearing 150 now.
Fullish length outside off, Holder drove it uppishly but safely to covers. There was a man placed at cover-point which was quite close to the batsman but the ball went just wide of him.
Fuller on the pads this time, Holder flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Shorter in length outside off, Holder gets into the position and punches it through covers for a boundary. There were two fielders in the ring but it was in the gap.
Fuller on off, Holder drives it to mid on.
Back of length on off, Holder camps back and defends it.
Angles it into the pads, JB flicks it through square leg for a run.
West Indies have managed to put the pressure back on the English bowlers after losing two wickets at the start. They have opted for an attacking approach which has paid off.
Angles it on the pads, Holder works it down to deep square leg for a couple.
JH wanted to hit that out of England! Shorter in length around off, Holder moves his front leg out of the way and tries to go big but does not connect.
EDGY FOUR! Fuller outside off, Holder tries to drive it but gets an outside edge through the vacant fourth slip area for a boundary. He deserves a bit of luck as he has played well up till now.
Good length outside off, Jason is in no mood to play at it.
Length outside off, Holder tries to force it through the off side but gets it off the inner half to the bowler.
Just short of a length on off, Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
He just loves pulling the ball! Bouncer on middle, Holder pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball around middle, nips away off the deck slightly. Holder tries to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Shortish length around off, Holder goes back and across and defends it.
Back of a length on off, Holder defends it off the back foot.
50-run stand between Holder and Blackwood.

Holder walks down the track. Seeing that Woakes bowls it short outside off. Jason drags his pull through mid-wicket for another couple of runs. This has been a quickfire partnership between the two after initial hiccups. England will be worried again!

In the air... but safe! Woakes bangs in a short ball, a loosener I should say. Holder takes on the challenge of pulling it but gets a top edge towards square leg. Moeen Ali stationed at mid-wicket hares after the ball but cannot reach it. The batsmen take two.
Root is not happy with the shape of the ball and he wants it to be checked. The umpire does so but everything is fine. There is also a bowling change. Chris Woakes replaces Stuart Broad.
Just ahead of a length on the stumps, Blackwood covers the line of the ball and defends it. A good comeback by Anderson after going for a boundary first ball.
Bowls it on a length around off, JB prods forward and defends it towards covers.
Back of a length on off, Blackwood gets into position and defends it.
Length on off, Blackwood defends it to mid off.
Good length outside off, Blackwood does not play at it.
FOUR! Crunched! Anderson bangs in a short one on middle, Blackwood rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary. The runs are flowing here.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Lands it on a length around off, Holder closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge through cover-point for a brace. Not convincing but Holder won't mind.

FOUR! This is the best of the three! Fuller in length by Broad on off, Holder leans into it and drives it through extra covers and the ball races to the fence. He holds the pose after playing it. It was a beautiful shot from the tall man.
FOUR! This is even better! Through the off side this time. A touch shorter outside off, Holder camps back and punches it through cover-point and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Easy for Holder! Short on leg stump, sits up to be hit. Holder swivels inside the crease and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length on middle, Blackwood tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
A lot of swing for Anderson! Length ball around off, swings way too much away from the batsman. Holder plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.

Intent form Holder! Anderson bowls it on the stumps, Holder shimmies down the track and tries to go big but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a good stop.
BEAUTY! Just ahead of a length around off, shaping away. Holder tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Full ball on middle, Holder continues his attacking approach. Lofts the ball over mid on for two.
Shorter in length aimed at the ribs of the batsman. Blackwood tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood slices it over point and takes two.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fullish length around off, Holder drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Holder plays it off the back foot.

Safe! Angles it into the pads, Blackwood flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a run. Holder wants a second and sets off for it but is sent back by Blackwood. The fielder fields the ball and throws it to the keeper who flicks it onto the stumps and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs to check but Holder has made his crease.
They have gone upstairs to check for a run out at the striker's end. Holder seems to be safe. Let's see what the replays show...
Fuller in length on the stumps, Blackwood drives it to mid on. Moeen Ali fields it safely and there is a loud cheer from the crowd.
FOUR! A lucky one! Shorter in length on middle, Blackwood tries to duck but hangs his bat up in the process. The ball hits the hanging willow and goes down to the third man fence. A periscope.
1000 Test runs for Jason Holder.

FOUR! The best way to get rid of pressure is to attack and it is exactly what Jason does. Anderson bowls a full ball on middle, Holder takes his front leg out of the way and hits it over mid on for a boundary.
Length outside off, Holder does not fiddle with it.
Angles it into the pads, Blackwood flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
WIDE! Bangs it short on middle. Bounces over the batsman's head and the umpire signals a wide.
Fuller in length, tailing back in. Blackwood misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. Might be missing leg.
Back of a length on off, Blackwood defends it watchfully.
Fuller in length around off, Holder drives it towards mid off.
Back of a length on off, Holder guides it to point.
Lovely stuff! Fuller in length around off, swinging away. Holder tries to drive but gets beaten.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Blackwood is hanging back in the crease. He is anticipating a short ball here.
Angles it into the batsman. Blackwood tries to defend it on the leg side but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
BOUNCER! The batsman does well to evade it.
Fuller on the pads, Holder misses the flick and is struck on the pads. There is a muted appeal from England but the umpire remains put.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to gully.
Good length on middle, Blackwood plays it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end but no harm done.
CUT INTO HALF! Angles it from wide of the crease on off, nips into the batsman. Blackwood is beaten on the inside edge and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Length outside off, Blackwood opts not to play at it.

FOUR! Almost another one for Anderson! Shorter outside off, which gets big on Blackwood who slashes at it. He gets an edge over Stokes at gully for a boundary. Doesn't matter what the game situation is, Jermaine will play his shots.
BEATEN! Lands it on a length around off, Holder pokes at it and gets beaten.
Bangs in a well-directed short ball. Blackwood tucks it  awkwardly away on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length on off, Blackwood defends it off the back foot.

Short and outside off, Blackwood goes for the cut but gets an outside edge on the bounce to first slip. The fielder half stops it with his hands and then the ball hits his knee. That must have hurt. Cook was the fielder.

DROPPED! England could have had another one there! Moeen Ali drops an absolute sitter. Fuller on off, Blackwood tries to play it through mid-wicket but hits it uppishly towards mid on who drops it. It's all happening out there, folks.
Lands it on a length outside off, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper.
Stuart Broad to operate from the other end. Attacking field for him as well.
Fuller in length around off, Holder drives it to mid off. An action-packed over. Runs, wickets, we had everything in the first over today. What a start!
Length outside off, Holder shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Holder times his push with an angled bat through gully for a boundary.
Well played, Holder! The hat-trick delivery was bowled a tad fuller on off, Jason lunges forward and defends.
Jason Holder strides out to the middle. Five slips and a gully in place for him.

OUT! Jimmy on fire! Two-in-two for him. Where was this England yesterday? An ideal start for them. Anderson bowls it just short of a length outside off, Dowrich pokes at it and gets an outside edge to Joe Root at second slip, who takes it. A golden duck for Dowrich. A collapse here? Anderson gets his 23rd Test fifer and is now on a hat-trick.
Shane Dowrich is the next man in. An extra slip in place for him.

OUT! What a start! A wicket off the first ball, exactly what England needed. The centurion has to depart early today. Anderson like always is right on the money. He pitches it on off and gets it to straighten just a touch. Hope tries to defend it but gets an outside edge to Jonny Bairstow who takes it easily. Hope after a brilliant innings walks back to a standing ovation. Anderson gets his fourth!

The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Blackwood and Hope will continue their innings. James Anderson will bowl the first over of the day. He has two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Hello and welcome to the 3rd day of the 2nd Test between England and West Indies at Headingley. The Windies have done the unthinkable and have shown great heart so far. The third day is often considered as the moving day of the Test match and they head into it in the driver's seat. They still have five wickets in hand and would try and extend their lead to something close to 200. England on the other hand, would want to replicate their bowling from the first Test and bundle out the away side as quickly as possible, to keep them in check. We are all set for an intriguing day of cricket. Stay tuned for all the action.
...Day 3, Session 1...

The hosts, on the other hand, tried everything possible before the second new ball but nothing worked. The second cherry did provide a little respite for them as they managed to take 2 wickets. They will come out fresh tomorrow and hope to trigger a collapse and fight their way back into the game. An exciting day of cricket awaits us tomorrow. Do join us at 1100 local (1000 GMT) for all the action. Till then, take care and cheers!

Shai Hope walks off to a standing ovation from the crowd and his dressing room. He along with Kraigg Brathwaite has turned the tide in favour of the visitors. The former is unbeaten on 147 while the latter got out after a brilliant 134. After stuttering at 35 for 3, ending the day with a lead of 71 is not something any of us would have expected from the Windies. They are in a commanding position at the moment and would look to bat England out of the game tomorrow.
FOUR! An extremely poor last ball by Moeen. Short and down the leg side. Blackwood camps back and pulls it through short fine leg for a boundary. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Floats it outside off, Blackwood leans into it and drives it through the vacant cover area for a couple.
The man from cover comes into silly point. Root wants to attack a little more here.
Flatter on off, Blackwood defends it off the front foot.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Tosses it on off, Blackwood drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Flatter on off, JB defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Blackwood drives it to covers.

Shorter in length, Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and wide outside off, inviting Hope to drive. Hope obliges and tries to drive but misses.
Bouncer on middle, Hope ducks under it.
Bangs it short on leg stump, does not bounce a lot. Blackwood tries to pull it but misses. The ball clips the pads and goes to fine leg for a leg bye.
Fires one down the leg side, fuller in length, Jermaine tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg and they take a leg bye.
FOUR! Shot! Anderson pitches it up outside off, a little bit of width on offer, Blackwood latches onto it and rockets it over covers for a boundary.
Moeen Ali is loosening up...
Blackwood covers the line of the delivery and offers a straight bat in defense. Solid.
On a length and outside off, shaping away, Blackwood shoulders arms.
Almost a yorker there, Jermaine does well to dig it out towards the leg side.
Angling into the batsman around off, Blackwood presses forward and defends it back.

Fuller on off, Blackwood drives it back to the bowler.
Drifts it on the pads, Blackwood works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Angles it into the pads, Blackwood tries to clip it but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length around off, Hope covers the line and blocks it.
Good length around off, Hope does well to evade it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Bowls it on the pads, Blackwood misses the flick and the ball hits the pads as it rolls towards the leg side for a leg bye.
Lands it on a length on middle, Hope tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! WOW! Short outside off, Blackwood slaps it through covers for a boundary. That is how he plays, he will play his shots.
Bouncer on middle, Blackwood ducks under it.
Jermaine Blackwood strides out to the middle.

OUT! There goes another! Just what England needed to boost their confidence, back-to-back wickets. Stokes gets his first and Chase who is having a torrid time in England is walking back. Bangs it short on off, gets big on Chase who fends at it awkwardly and gets an outside edge to Cook at first slip. He makes no mistake and takes a good reverse cup catch in front of his face. England crawling their way back into the game. West Indies lead by 38 runs.

Shorter on middle, Shai works it to square leg for a run.

OUT! TIMBER! Broad finally gets the breakthrough that England desperately needed! Kraigg Brathwaite is the man who has to walk back and he is walking back to a standing ovation from the crowd. It has been a superb knock by him and he deserves all the appreciation he is getting. Stuart bowls it form wide of the crease and angles it on a length around off, getting it to jag in sharply. Brathwaite tries defending from the crease but it stays low as well and goes through to hit the middle stump. Top delivery by Broad. The 246-run partnership has been broken, West Indies lead by 23 runs. Is this the opening England needed?
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Time for Drinks.
A touch fuller on leg stump, Hope plays it with a straight bat to mid on.
FOUR! This is even better! One of the hardest shots to play in the game and he does it brilliantly. Fuller in length on middle, Hope on drives it down the ground for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Poor line! Drifts it on the pads, Hope shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length on middle, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it straight back towards the bowler.

NOT OUT! England continue to waste their reviews. This time on Hope though. Fuller on the pads, sliding down the leg side, Hope goes for the flick but misses and the ball goes off something to Bairstow. He collects the ball by diving to his left and appeals. The umpire shakes his head. Jonny insisted for the review and Joe Root takes it. Replays show there was day-light between bat and ball and the deflection was there as it brushed the pads. The on-field call remains.
A review for caught behind against Shai Hope has been taken by England. Woakes does not look sure here. Root has a chat with his keeper and then goes for the DRS.
Bowled on the pads, Hope works it down to fine leg for a run.

Angles it into the pads, Brathwaite taps it in front of mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder comes running in, picks the ball up and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. No harm done a single added.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
A tad fuller on off, moves away off the deck. Takes the outside edge as Hope tries to defend and goes towards third man. The fielder from point runs after the ball and keeps it down to a single.
Good length outside off, swings away late. Hope watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hope is not in the mood to play at it.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

FOUR! Similar line, similar length and similar shot. Short outside off, Brathwaite who has played the cut shot so well does it again. The ball goes past the diving point fielder and races to the fence.
FOUR! A hit me ball there by Woakes. Short and wide outside off, sits up to be hit. Brathwaite cuts it through point for a boundary.
A little shorter in length around off, Kraigg pushes it to mid off.
Angles it on the pads, Brathwaite flicks it through square leg for a couple. Easy two there for the batsman. The Windies have taken the lead now.
Starts off with a fuller length on off, Brathwaite drives it back to where it came from.
Chris Woakes is back into the attack. England would hope he provides them the breakthrough they need dearly. He has three slips and a gully.
A touch fuller in length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on a length into the batsman, the ball also stays a touch low. Hope does well to adjust and keep it out.
Fuller in length, Hope eases it to mid off. That made a cracking sound of the bat.
On a length on off, Hope defends it by covering the line fo the ball.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Fuller on off, Brathwaite times it through mid off. Moeen Ali stationed there hares after it and pulls it back before the rope. Three taken by the batsmen. Scores are level now.
FOUR! Waits for the bad delivery and puts it away! Fuller on off, Hope drives it through mid off and the ball goes to the boundary. They trail by just three now.
Just ahead of a length outside off, hoping for an edge but Hope is not interested in playing at it.
Brave leave! Good length around off, Hope does not play at it. That was close to his pads. A good leave by him.
Length outside off, Hope points his bat skywards and lets it through.
They are playing with really soft hands! Length around off, Hope tries to defend but gets an edge which falls way short of Stokes at gully.
An away swinger outside off, Hope opts not to play at it.
Back of a length on middle, Kraigg tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller on the stumps, Hope tries to drive but the ball goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
BEATEN! On a length around off, straightens a touch. Hope is beaten as he tries to defend it.
Lands it on a length around off, Hope defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! A lovely shot, that! A loosener, full and on middle, Hope drives it back past the bowler with a very straight bat. The fielder from mid on gives it a chase and also dives in an attempt to stop the ball but all in vain as the ball crosses the fence. The Windies trail by only 8 runs.
Stuart Broad is into the attack now.
Just short of a length, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and pushes it towards mid off. This is bread and butter for him. He loves playing on the back foot.
Bowls it on a length on off, Brathwaite defends it with authority.
Fuller in length outside off, great seam positioning. Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper.
Good length on off, Brathwaite defends it solidly.
Good length on middle, Kraigg defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length around off, KB tries to defend but gets an outside edge on the bounce to gully.
The new ball is now available and they have taken it immediately. James Anderson is brought back into the attack.
Shorter outside off, Brathwaite plays it towards point for a run.
A crowd catch there! Fuller outside off, Brathwaite hits it into the ground and on the bounce to covers.
Clips it with the turn to short fine leg.
Fires it on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
That was very nicley played! Slower through the air on middle, Hope eases it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on the stumps, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
Plays with the spin and helps it to backward square leg.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Floated full ball on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
There is the arm ball by Westley, the variation, Kraigg keeps it out safely to covers.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Edged, didn't carry! Flatter and outside off, staying a touch low, the batsman gets across to defend but it takes the outside edge. Falls short of Stokes at first slip.
Flighted ball around off, turning back in. Hope tries to drive it towards mid off but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Hope prods forward in defense.
Bowls it on the pads, Hope tucks it on the leg side for no runs.
Quicker on middle, turning into the batsman. Hope tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads.
Flatter on leg stump, Hope pads it away.
Plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length outside off, Hope plays it towards point for a run.
Darts it down the leg side, Hope misses the flick and it goes through to the keeper.
Quicker on the stumps, Hope camps back and defends it.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Bowls a flatter ball outside off, it goes on with the arm. Hope tries to defend it but gets beaten. Bairstow makes a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Quicker on off, Hope defends it solidly.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tosses it up outside off, turning back in. KB defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on off, Kraigg defends it off the front foot.

Floated it on middle, Brathwaite sweeps it fine down the leg side. Malan from short fine leg gives it a chase and slides and pushes the ball back in play. The umpire goes upstairs to check whether he touched the rope while pulling the ball back. Replays show that he has done well. He saves two for his team.
Darts it on the pads, Brathwaite tucks it to short leg.
Works it to mid-wicket with the spin.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Quicker on off, Hope lunges forward and blocks it.
Flatter on off, Hope camps back and defends it.
Brathwaite uses his feet and drives it down to deep mid on for a run.
Shorter on off, Brathwaite pushes it on the off side.
Tom Westley to have another go. Seems, England quickly want to bowl out the remaining six overs in order to get the second new ball.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Plays it with the spin towards the leg side for a run.
Quicker on the pads, Kraigg flicks it towards short fine leg. The fielder at short fine leg does well to dive to his right and stop the ball.

NOT OUT! Another review wasted by the home side and both of them were against Brathwaite. Moeen bowls it flatter outside off, turning into the batsman. Brathwaite shuffles across and tries to work it on the leg side but misses and the ball hits the pads. The English players go up in an appeal but the umpire gives it not out. Root after consulting his teammates decides to review. Replays show that there was no bat involved but the impact was outside off. The on-field call stays. The home side have lost both their review.
England have taken a review for lbw against Kraigg Brathwaite. Looks like the impact is outside the line.
Drags his length back on middle, Hope clips it with the spin through the leg side for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Hope plants his front foot ahead and blocks it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
200-run stand up between Shai Hope and Kraigg Brathwaite.

FOUR! Fuller outside off this time, Brathwaite lunges forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. This also brings up the 200-run partnership between the two. They continue to make England sweat in the field.
Back of a length outside off, Hope punches it through the covers. The point fielder gives it a chase and pulls it back just inside the rope. The batsmen run three.
Back of a length around off, comes in with the angle and also bounces a touch more. Hope does well to block it.
A very full ball outside off, trying to suck Hope into the drive. Shai resists and opts not to play at it.
Fires it down the leg side, Brathwaite pads it away.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on off, Kraigg defends it watchfully.
Quicker through the air on off, KG defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Flatter down the leg side, Brathwaite flicks it on the leg side.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite taps it on the off side for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, KB cuts it through point for a couple.
Lands it on a length around off, Brathwaite drives it to cover.
Maiden Test century for Shai Hope.

Hundred for Shai Hope! What a time to bring up his first ton, when his team needed it the most. Not quite in the style his partner did, but he won't mind. Back of a length on leg stump, Hope flicks it down to fine leg for a run. Big cheer from the crowd, this knock and his partnership surely would have stunned a few.
FOUR! He moves onto 99! Shorter on leg stump, Hope rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. He almost took out the umpire with that shot.
FOUR! The leg slip fielder had a chance there. Moeen fires it on the pads, Brathwaite tickles it uppishly past the diving leg slip fielder and down to the fine leg boundary.
Loopy ball on middle, KB prods forward and blocks it.
Tosses it up on off, Kraigg defends by lunging forward.
Moeen bowls it on the leg stump, Brathwaite pads it away.
Drags his length back on leg stump, Hope flicks it fine down the leg side for a run.
FOUR! That was caressed through the off side. Full outside off, Hope gets right to the pitch of the ball and drives it through covers for a boundary. He moves onto 94.
Shorter in length outside off, Hope plays it towards point for a run.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it from wide of the crease on a length around off, nips away off the deck. Hope pokes at it and gets beaten.
FOUR! STREAKY! Good length on off, straightens a touch. Hope tries to defend it but gets an outside edge through the vacant third slip region for a boundary.
Length on off, Hope tries to defend it but it takes the outside edge to gully.
Angles it on the pads, Brathwaite tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Ben Stokes will bowl from the other end. He has two slips and a gully in place.
Shorter in length on off, Hope punches it towards mid on.
Flatter on off, turning back in, Hope works it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, Hope covers the line and blocks it.
Quicker on off, Hope defends it off the front foot.
Starts off with a flatter one on off, which stays very, very low. Hope does extremely well to get his bat down in time and it hits the bottom.

The men in concern are out in the middle. Kraigg Brathwaite and Shai Hope will want to continue from where they left before the break. Moeen Ali will bowl the first over after the break. He has a slip and a leg slip in place for him.
...Day 2, Session 3...

England bowlers tried their heart out in the afternoon session. But once the ball stopped doing something, their bowlers started looking clueless. 13 overs more and they will have a brand new cherry to operate with. That will be a big moment in this game, if the current partnership lasts till then. Anyway, it's the Windies on top currently. Do join us in a short while for some more action.

Cricket is a game of great uncertainties. When we were talking - how long will West Indies last on this tasty pitch for the bowlers - they respond with a wicketless session. Kraigg Brathwaite and Shai Hope have shown tremendous potential in this partnership and they are not done yet. The deficit is down to only 52 now and by stumps today, they could very well be in the lead. Now, who would have thought that? Certainly, not me.
Slower through the air on off, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot. TEA ON DAY 2!
6th Test hundred for Kraigg Brathwaite.

SIX! What a shot! He reached his 50 with a maximum and he does the same to get to his hundred. A knock of great character by the Windies opener. Westley bowls a loopy ball on off, Brathwaite comes down the track and hits it over the long on fence for a biggie. We have seen him play that shot to the spinners a lot of time. The visitors now trail by another 52 runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball outside off, turning back into the batsman. Hope tries to push it on the off side but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Works it with the spin down to fine leg for a couple.
Tosses it full on off, Hope drives it back to the bowler.
Tom Westley is now into the attack.
Full on the pads, Hope flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! WOW! Straight as an arrow! Full ball on the stumps, Hope drives it past the bowler, showing the full face of the bat and it races to the fence.
Angles it into the pads, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.

EDGY FOUR! Through the slip cordon. This will be so frustrating England. Nothing is going their way. Fuller on off, Hope tries to drive but gets an outside edge between slips and gully and the ball races to the fence.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted on off, Hope drives it towards mid off for a run.

DROPPED! Sharp chance! Not an easy one when you are standing so close and it comes out of the middle of the bat. Moeen drags his length back on off, turning in. Hope goes back and clips it uppishly straight to short leg. Stoneman there is late to react and it hits him on the body.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! 150-run stand up between the two. This is one heck of a partnership here for the Windies. Moeen bowls it short and wide outside off, Hope camps back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Flatter on off, turning back in. Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
Floats it on off, Hope drives it to mid off.
Angles it into the pads, KB tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Kraigg shoulders his arms to it.
Almost an edge! What a delivery to get when you are in your nervous 90s! Lands it on a length from wide of the crease on off, straightens a touch. Brathwaite pokes at it and gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite covers the line and defends.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

A tad fuller on leg stump, straightens a touch. Brathwaite tries to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge past the diving Ben Stokes at gully. The fielder from point hares after it and keeps it down to two. Not convincing but Kraigg won't mind it. He moves onto 96.
Stuart Broad is back for a spell before the tea break.
Full outside off, Hope drives it to covers.
Tosses it full on off, Brathwaite drives it towards long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Hope works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Drives it with the spin towards long on for a run.

Floats it on middle, Hope sweeps it through square leg. Cook makes good ground to his left and stops a certain boundary. The batsmen run only one. Excellent effort from the ex-England skipper. He fielding in the deep is a rarity and the crowd certainly enjoyed his throw to the keeper. A big loud cheer!
FOUR! Classical cover drive! Moeen tosses it up outside off, Hope plants his front foot ahead and drives it through extra cover for a boundary. Top shot, that.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Comes over the wicket and bowls it outside off, Brathwaite does not bother playing at it.
Fuller on leg stump, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Poor by Stokes. He has a leg slip in place and he is bowling from around the wicket. The plan here must be to bowl at the ribs of the batsman but he is offering a lot of width. Shorter outside off, Brathwaite punches it through covers and the ball races to the fence. He is on 92 now.
FOUR! He did well to reach that! Very wide and on the shorter side outside off. Brathwaite stretches and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Back of a length on middle, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
Works it to mid-wicket with the spin.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Gives it air on off, Kraigg drives it to long on for a run.
Floats it on off, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Loopy ball on middle, turning into the batsman. Brathwaite flicks it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a brace.

Drags his length back outside off, Brathwaite goes for the cut but it's a half-hearted attempt and as a result not much conviction or timing behind it. The first slip fielder gets to his right to pick up the ball.
Short in length this time, angling away from the batsman outside off, Hope rises on his back foot and looks to play at it initially. However, he aborts the plan at the last minute.
Change of plans from Stokes. He switches to round the wicket and fires in a near yorker around leg, Hope leans forward and across before keeping it out to square leg.
Length ball landing outside off, shaping back in, Hope watchfully blocks it back.
Bouncer around leg, a harmless one, Hope ducks underneath it.
Angles in a good length ball this time, around off, Hope covers the line and defends it watchfully.
Stokes runs in and angles in a back of a length delivery outside off, Hope gets back and taps it down to point.

NOT OUT! A waste of a review by England. It was taken in desperation, you can say. Moeen tosses it outside off, spinning back into the batsman. Brathwaite lunges forward in defense but is beaten by the inward turn. The ball goes off something to Ben Stokes at first slip who catches it and appeals. The umpire remains put.  Root after a chat with his teammates decides to review and they go upstairs. Replays show there was no inside edge on that one and it has clipped the front pad before going to Ben at first slip. Just because of the protocol, they check for the lbw as well but the impact was way outside off. The on-field decision stands. England lose one review.
England have taken a review against Kraigg Brathwaite for a catch at first slip.
Slower through the air this time outside off,  Kraigg dives it to covers.

Aims it at the rib cage of the batsman. Kraigg tucks it to leg gully.
A good bouncer! Shorter in length on off, Brathwaite tries to defend it but the ball gets big on him and goes through to the keeper as he gets beaten.
Short and wide outside off, Brathwaite goes for the cut but misses. Bairstow appeals after collecting the ball but nothing from the umpire.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite opts not to play at it.
Shorter in length, angling into the batsman. Brathwaite tucks it to backward square leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Plays it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Fuller outside off, KB drives it to mid on.

Floats it on off, Brathwaite prods forward and blocks it.
Tosses it up outside off, turning back in. Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bangs in a short delivery on leg stump, Hope ducks under it. With the ball not moving a lot, the England bowlers are looking clueless at the moment.
Length outside off, Hope pushes it towards point for no run.
Fuller in length on off, Hope defends it off the front foot.
Shorter in length outside off, Hope jumps and guides it to gully.
Bouncer on leg stump, Hope ducks under it.
Turn and bounce! Gives it air outside off, turning back in and also bounces off the surface. Brathwaite tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the body.
Flatter on middle, Kraigg defends it watchfully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball outside off, Brathwaite drives it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, turning back in. Brathwaite plays it to short leg.
FOUR! Tosses it up outside off, Brathwaite plants his front foot ahead and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. The deficit is below 100 now.
Angles it into the pads from wide of the crease. Brathwaite tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Shorter in length down the leg side, Kraigg lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on the pads, Hope tucks it around the corner for a run.
Shai Hope has been hit on the helmet and he seems in a bit of discomfort. The physio is out to check if he is okay. Also, there is a change of helmet.

BANG! That has hit Shai Hope flush on the helmet. Stokes bangs in a short ball on middle, which skids off the surface. Hope picks it late and tries to move out of the line but fails to do so. He gets hit on the helmet. Stokes immediately goes up to him and asks him whether he is fine. Good gesture there by Ben.
Bowls a bouncer on leg stump, Hope ducks under it.

Drinks time. What a session this is turning out to be for the visiting team! Both Shai and Kraigg have batted superbly and are amidst a century stand. They are slowly eating out the deficit and England will be worried now.
Fires it on off, Brathwaite camps back and defends it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.

Anderson comes around the wicket and angles it across the right-hander outside off, Brathwaite does not play at it.

Lands it on a length outside off, swinging away further. Brathwaite does not fiddle with it.

Punched off the backfoot by the batsman.
100-run stand between Shai Hope and Kraigg Brathwaite.

Length on off, Hope gets it off the outer half to gully.
Back of a length aimed at the ribs of the batsman. Kraigg tucks it around the corner for a run.
Fullish length on middle, Brathwaite plays it towards mid on.

2nd Test fifty for Shai Hope.

FOUR! A vital, vital knock from Shai Hope. He brings up his fifty in style. Fuller on off, Hope leans into it and drives it straight through mid off for a boundary. He knows he still has a long way to go.
Length ball just outside off, Hope does not bother playing at it.
Good length around off, Hope taps in front of covers and takes a run.
Fullish length on off, Hope plants his front foot ahead and drives it to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Off the edge again! Excellent length delivery outside off, swings a touch away from the batsman. Hope tries to drive but gets an outside edge through backward point for a boundary. There has been a lot of runs scored in the third man area. Maybe place a fielder there.
Lands it on a length on the stumps, Hope prods forward and defends it.
FOUR! Top shot! A tad shorter in length outside off, sits up to be hit. Hope stands tall and punches it through covers for a boundary.
James Anderson will bowl from the other end. He also has four slips in place for him.
Length outside off, Brathwaite shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length with width on offer, Hope punches it past the diving backward point fielder for three.
Fuller in length swinging away. Hope covers the swing by taking his front foot towards the ball and drives it through point for a couple.
An away swinger outside off, Hope watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope lunges forward in defense.
Chris Woakes pulls out of his delivery stride.
Starts off with a length delivery on leg stump, Kraigg Brathwaite shuffles across and flicks it through backward square leg for a run.

The players and the umpires are out and we are all set for the action to resume. Shai Hope and Kraigg Brathwaite will continue their innings. Chris Woakes will start the proceedings for the home side after the break. He has four slips in place for him.
...Day 2, Session 2...

Shai Hope and Kraigg Brathwaite to the rescue for the Windies. They will be extremely happy with how the session panned out. They started off in torrid fashion losing two early wickets, both to James Anderson but the two batsmen, with a slice of luck and good intent, have shifted the momentum towards the tourists. They now trail by another 149 runs and would hope these two will do the majority of the scoring. England, on the other hand, need quick wickets or they will soon be chasing the game. Join us for an exciting second session in a while.

Edged and short again! Quicker through the air on off, goes on with the arm. Hope plays for the turn but there isn't any. The ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to Stokes at first slip. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Gives it air on off, Brathwaite reaches out for it and works it with the spin down to long on for a run. Gives the strike to Hope who will play the last ball of the session.
Fires it in on off, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and defends it.
Tosses it up on off, Brathwaite lunges forward in defense.
Flatter on off, KB defends it watchfully.
Works it with the spin on the leg side.
Length around off, Hope gets it off the outer half towards the fourth slip fielder as he attempts to drive. No need to chase those!
Bangs in a short one, Hope ducks under it.
Shortish length outside off, Hope plays it to the point region. Good effort by the fielder to save runs for his team.
Shorter in length, Brathwaite hops and taps it towards point and completes a run. Stokes is frustrated as he did not want that single to be given.

FOUR! Everything here is going the visitors' way. Full and wide outside off, inviting Brathwaite to drive. He obliges and goes hard at it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies over Root standing at second slip for a boundary.
Very wide outside off, Brathwaite does not play at it.
Fuller outside off, Hope drives it square on the off side towards the point fielder.
Fires it in on off, Hope defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up, turning back in. Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the spin to short leg.
Flatter on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! A gift for Hope! A juicy full toss outside off, Hope leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Shorter in length on the stumps, KB defends it from within the crease.

Wider of the crease and angles it into the pads, Hope shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket. The square leg fielder gives it a chase and does well to stop the ball before the boundary line. He saves a run for his team.
Bowls it wide outside off, Hope is in no mood to play at it.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite hops and taps it in front of covers for a run.
Fuller on middle, gets it to shape back in. Hope gets it off the inner half through short fine leg for a run.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Gives it air and bowls it full outside off, Brathwaite drives it to covers.
Loopy ball on off, Kraigg defends it solidly.
Floats it on off, turning back in. Brathwaite tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Great use of the feet. He did it in the last over, he does it again. Comes down the track to the flighted ball on off and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter on off, Brathwaite plays it off the back foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Brathwaite drives it to mid off.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.

Another appeal but nothing from the umpire. Bowls a big inswinger from outside off, Hope is late onto the shot and the ball hits him on the pads. It looked close to the naked eye but replays show that Hope had hit that. There was a chat between Root and Stokes for a review but they opt not to go for it. Good call in the end.

Was there an edge? Stokes lands it on a length around off from wide of the crease. It straightens a touch. Hope is squared up in his defense and it goes to the keeper off something. The English players appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays show this one had also flicked the pads like the previous one. An excellent, excellent decision from the umpire.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
That stays low! Good length outside off, Hope tries to defend but is beaten by the low bounce and the ball just misses the off stump.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to it.

Nasser Hussain on-air mentions that Stuart Broad's wrist has not been very upright compared to Anderson and Woakes. His wrist is more towards fine leg which helps him get the inward movement but does not threaten the outside edge a lot, especially on a ground where there are more dismissals in the slip region - 5 catches per match on an average, the highest in the country, Nass provides the stats.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
13th Test fifty for Kraigg Brathwaite!

SIX! Reaches his fifty in style. Has batted exceedingly well under challenging conditions. Another off spinning delivery by Moeen, Brathwaite jumps out of the crease and sends it packing over mid-wicket for a biggie. Good connection, good intent, it has been a top knock so far from the opener.

The impact indeed is outside off. Moeen gets a delivery to spin back in sharply from outside off. Brathwaite goes a bit across the stumps to work it around but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Kraigg opts for the review and the Hawk Eye shows that the impact was outside off, although it was hitting the stumps. A couple of good reviews by West Indies.
Shout for an lbw! Up goes the finger and the batsman reviews it. Impact seems to be the issue. Let's see.
Offers width outside off, it's eased away through backward point for a couple of runs.
Turning back into the batsman and staying low, Hope does well to keep it out and pushes it down towards long on for one.
Flighted and full on off, Brathwaite drives it down the ground past the bowler for a single. The mid on fielder cuts it off.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack. A slip and short leg in place.
Angles it onto the pads, Hope flicks it to square leg.
Bowls a ball wide of off this time, Hope is in no mood to play at it.
Sprays it down the leg side, Hope tries to flick but misses.
Bowls it on a length on middle, Hope clips it to mid-wicket.
Goes wider on the crease and angles it into the pads. KB flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite pushes it back to the bowler.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack. He was brilliant with the bat, can he repeat the same with the ball?
A tad fuller outside off, Hope does not fiddle with it.
Good length around off, Hope defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Good batting from Hope! Anticipates the inswinger, he walks across to the full ball on leg and flicks it down to the fine leg boundary. These two are going along well here.
Goes from wide of the crease, and bowls a big inswinger down the leg side. Hope misses the flick and Bairstow does well to collect the ball with a dive.
Almost a drag on! Broad bowls it on a length, it nips back in sharply. Brathwaite tries to defend but gets an inside edge which bounces above the stumps and goes to the keeper.
Angles it into the pads, Brathwaite tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Beaten! Length ball moving away from the batsman around off, Hope tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Fuller in length around off, Hope plays it in front of covers and the batsmen cross.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hope does not bother playing at it.
FOUR! Shorter in length outside off, sits up to be hit. Hope gets into position and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Lands it on a length around off, KB tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length around middle, jagging back into the batsman. Brathwaite tries to flick but misses and is struck high on the pads.
FOUR BYES! Sprays it down the leg side, Brathwaite misses the flick and the keeper is unable to collect it as the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Drifts on the pads, Hope flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Angles it into the pads, Brathwaite nudges it down to fine leg for a run.

Nasser Hussain on-air mentions that Kraigg Brathwaite plays late and also with soft hands.  Hence his edges do not carry to the slip fielders. Interestingly, he brings out the example of Ben Stokes who is completely a different player as he goes hard at the ball and plays more on the front foot. We saw him edging quite a few through the slip cordon yesterday but the Windies players were too kind to take those chances.
Beaten all ends up! Excellent delivery, on a length just outside off, holding its line, Hope is caught pushing and missing inside the crease.

FOUR! Controls the shot quite well in the end! A fuller length delivery outside off, shaping away a shade, Shai is on the front foot with an angled bat to defend. Plays it with soft hands and it takes the outer half before running past gully for a boundary.
Good length delivery around off, Hope stays back inside the crease to block it safely.
A watchful leave on this occasion by Shai Hope. The line is a testing one outside off and Woakes should persist with it.

Aahhh...tries to be greedy here. Attempts to bowl the previous delivery from the middle stump line. But as it happens many times, the ball just skids through rather than moving away. Hope plays it out from his pads to the leg side.
Play and a miss! Pitches it up around off, without much footwork Hope tries to play at it and gets beaten.
Length around off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite covers the line and blocks it.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Brathwaite rocks back and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Lands it on a length around off, KB defends it off the back foot.

NOT OUT! A successful review for the Windies! Brathwaite survives. Broad bowls a fuller ball angling into the batsman, Brathwaite tries to defend but misses and it hits him on the pads. The English players appeal and the umpire gives it out. It looks very plumb but Brathwaite reviews straightaway. They go upstairs and guess what, the replays show there was a faint inside edge. The decision has to be overturned. Kraigg Brathwaite lives to fight another day and the Windies will breathe a sigh of relief.
Brathwaite has been adjudged lbw and he reviews. Maybe he thinks he has hit it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Time for drinks. A good hour for the home team where they took a couple of wickets. We have witnessed some cracking bowling from Anderson and Broad. Really testing the Windies batting. Hang on, there is a bit of rain in the air but not threatening enough as of now.
Length on off, Hope camps back and blocks it.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.

What a ball! Too good, almost a perfect delivery. Comes closer to the stumps and bowls it on a length around middle. Woakes gets some movement away from the batsman who gets squared up in defense and it goes off something to Bairstow. The English players appeal but the umpire stays put. A great decision there. Replays confirm that it had gone off the pad and not the edge of the bat. Also it would have been too high to be given lbw.
Lands it on a length around off, Hope tries to defend but gets beaten.

FOUR! Through the slip cordon again. Another one which does not carry. This will surely be frustrating the English bowlers. Good length around off, shaping away. Hope plays at it with soft hands and gets an outside edge which falls short of second slip who cannot stop it. The ball races to the fence.
Good length outside off, zips through the surface. Hope tries to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten.

Michael Holding on-air makes a fair point. He is of the opinion that the West Indies players in general lack basic cricket sense. He gives the example of the previous Test match where they were allowing easy singles to the English batsmen and while batting, they were not good with their running. Agrees that the young players have not played much of international cricket but at the same time is not ready to take that as an excuse.
Good length on off, Kraigg defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Through the leg side this time. Angles it into the pads, Brathwaite flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Broad, so far, has not settled in.
Short and wide outside off, Brathwaite tries to cut but gets beaten. He hit a similar ball for a boundary on the first ball but missed this one.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Starts off with a loosener outside off. Short and width on offer. Brathwaite gets into the position early and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Stuart Broad is back into the attack.
FOUR! Edgy again. Woakes bowls it from wide of the crease on off, gets it to move away. Hope tries to push at it but it takes an outside edge through gully and runs into the third man fence.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite taps it in front of cover-point for a run.
Tries to bowl the magic delivery from leg to off, but it gets no swing and drifts on the pads. Hope tucks it on the leg side for a run.
That moved a long way. Length around off, pitches and moves away from the batsman. Hope watches it go through to the keeper.
Beaten again! A tad fuller on off, swinging away. Hope tries to defend but gets beaten.
Lovely seam movement! Length outside off, Hope pushes inside the line and gets beaten.
Angles it into the pads, Hope clips it through square leg for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, Hope does not fiddle with it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Comes closer to the stumps and bowls an outswinger outside off. Hope plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length around off, Hope defends it solidly.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. It shapes away though after landing. Brathwaite lets it be.
Fuller in length on off, Brathwaite drives it to covers.
Lands it on a length around off, Kraigg prods forward and defends it.
Good length outside off, Kraigg shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length on off, KB defends it watchfully.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller and tailing back in on off. Hope does well to get his bat down in time and defend it.
Shai Hope walks out to the middle, replacing his brother.

OUT! Captain fantastic! Lovely catch by Root at second slip. Anderson gets his third. Bowls an inswinger around off, Kyle with poor footwork pushes at it with hard hands. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of Joe who dives and takes a brilliant catch. The Windies are in some early trouble now.

Fuller in length on off, Hope leans into it and drives it through covers. He does not time it and Broad gives it a chase from mid off. They complete a run and then go for a second. Broad picks up the ball and throws it at the non-striker's end but misses and they complete the second. Had Broad hit there, Brathwaite was a goner. He was well short of his crease.
Back of a length on off, KH guides it to point and refuses a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length on middle, KB tucks it around the corner for a run.
Lovely, lovely bowling. Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Gets some shape away from off. Hope tries to defend it but gets beaten. Beautiful over by Woakes.
Back of a length on off, Hope guides it to point.
BEATEN! Brilliant seam positioning by Woakes. Perfect outswinger. Length around off, moving away from the batsman. Hope pokes at it and gets beaten.
Good length around off, Hope watchfully leaves it.
On a length this time, outside off. Hope lets it be.
He gets swing straightaway. Fuller outside off, shaping away. Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Chris Woakes is into the attack. He had a wonderful 18 months with the ball before getting injured. Four slips in place for him.
Fuller in length on off, wanting Brathwaite to drive. He obliges and drives it to extra cover. Not in the gap though.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
A touch fuller outside off, swinging away. Brathwaite opts not to play at it.
Good length on off, KH taps it in front of covers and changes strike. Good running by the two batsmen.
Length outside off, Hope points his bat skywards and lets it through to the keeper.
Bowls an inswinger on middle, Hope clips it to mid-wicket.
Comes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Kraigg tucks it to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length on off, Brathwaite defends it towards mid off.
Good length around off, Kraigg lunges forward and keeps it out.
Fuller in length on off, KB drives it off the inner half to the bowler.
Edged but short! Good length around off, nips away off the deck. Brathwaite pokes at it and gets an outside edge which falls short of Alastair Cook at first slip.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller this time on off, Hope drives it to mid off.
Good length outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to it.
Kyle Hope is the next man in.

OUT! Anderson strikes! Bishoo finally edges one to England's delight. It was just a matter of time. Shorter in length outside off, Bishoo's eyes lit up seeing the width, tries to cut it but gets an outside edge straight to Jonny Bairstow who makes no mistake. The nightwatchman has to walk back. An early wicket for the home team, just what they wanted. West Indies trail by 227 runs.
Fuller outside off, inviting him for the drive. Bishoo obliges but does not connect.
Ball, after ball, after ball. Fuller this time around off, Bishoo tries to defend it but is again beaten on the outside edge.
And again! Good length on middle, angled across the batsman. Bishoo pokes at it and gets beaten.
Good length around off, searching for the edge but KB is solid in defense.
Broad comes steaming in and angles it into the batsman from wide of the crease. Brathwaite plays it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! STREAKY! Length ball on off, straightens a touch. Brathwaite plays it with soft hands but gets an outside edge through backward point and the ball races away.
A touch fuller this time on off, angling into the batsman. Kraigg lunges forward and blocks it.
Back to bowling length on off, KB defends it by covering the line of the stumps.
FOUR! Easy for Brathwaite. Broad sprays on the pads, from wide of the crease. Kraigg tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fuller in length, tailing back in. Bishoo stays a bit leg side of the ball and drives it to mid off.
Shorter in length around off, Bishoo defends it solidly.
Back of a length on middle, no swing this time. Bishoo camps back and defends it.
Lovely stuff! The away swinger this time. Good length around off, angling across. Bishoo tries to defend but gets beaten. Anderson is moving the ball both ways.
Fuller this time outside off, Bishoo does not fiddle with it.

Good length around middle, gets some inward movement. Brathwaite is stranded in the crease as he tries to flick. He misses and the ball hits him high on the pads. There is a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Bangs in a bouncer on middle. Kraigg ducks under it.

EDGY FOUR! Serves it on a length around off, straightens a touch. Brathwaite tries to defend but gets an outside edge which falls short of Root at second slip. It goes through his legs and into the boundary. First runs for the day.
Lands it on a length on middle, from wide of the crease. KB defends it solidly.
Short and outside off, Brathwaite mistimes his cut to covers.
Slightly shorter in length around middle, gets big on Kraigg. He does well to keep the ball down and tuck it towards mid-wicket.
Stuart Broad will bowl from the other end. He too has four slips in place for him.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bishoo does not bother playing at it. A testing over to begin proceedings...
Length outside off, Bishoo lets it be.
CLOSE SHAVE! That came back in sharply! An inswinger this time, coming in from outside off. Bishoo shoulders his arms to it and the ball goes agonizingly over the stumps.
BEATEN! Lovely start by Anderson. Short of a length, angling away. Bishoo pokes at it and gets beaten. There are four slips waiting for the edge.
Back of a length on middle, Devendra covers the line and defends it off the back foot.
Right on the money! Starts off with a length delivery around middle, angling across the batsman. Bishoo first thinks of playing at it but then takes his bat out of the way. A good start by Anderson.

The men concerned are out in the middle. Kraigg Brathwaite and Devendra Bishoo will continue their innings. James Anderson will bowl the first over of the day for England. He has four slips in place for him. Let's play...

Surprise, surprise! We head into day two of the second Test between England and West Indies, it is the visitors and not the hosts who have the upper hand. With still a long way to go in the game, it will all rest on how the away side bats today. A lot will depend on the likes of Kraigg Brathwaite, Jermaine Blackwood and Shai Hope if the Windies are to surpass or get close to the hosts' total. For England, with the bowling attack they posses and the pitch also providing a lot of assistance, a collapse cannot be ruled out. Let us see what happens. Welcome to the coverage.
...Day 2, Session 1...

The visitors would want to come out tomorrow and try to get close to the English total. They would hope that their batsmen show some resistance and fight it out. The hosts, on the other hand, would want to run through this fragile batting line-up and get a comfortable lead. Do join us for day 2 tomorrow at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, take care and cheers!

A near perfect day for the Windies! They battled out the tricky period really well by adding 19 runs and losing the lone wicket of Powell, who fell prey to Anderson. They still trail by another 239 runs and it won't be easy for them as the wicket is providing good assistance to the seam bowlers. Earlier in the day, England after winning the toss and opting to bat, were bowled out for 258 with Stokes scoring a ton for them and Roach and Gabriel bagging four wickets each for the Windies.
Sees it off safely! Lands it on a length around off, Brathwaite taps it down with soft hands towards the slip cordon. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Angles it onto the pads, Brathwaite flicks it to fine leg for a couple and he will face the last ball of the day as well. Waste of a nightwatchman?
Two close-in fielders on the leg side. A short leg and short mid-wicket in place...
Gets some swing away from the batsman but bowls it too wide outside off to bother the batsman.
A tad shorter on middle, KB defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Shorter outside off, Kraigg plays it towards point.
Woakes starts off with a length ball around off, Brathwaite defends it watchfully.
Chris Woakes to bowl the final over of the day.
Full and wide outside off, Bishoo points his bat skywards and lets it through to the keeper. That will be it for Anderson today.
Fuller on the stumps, Bishoo with no feet movement at all defends it.
Sprays it down the leg side, Bishoo misses the flick.
Lands it on a length on off, DB defends it solidly.
Over the wicket this time. Angles it across the off stump. Bishoo does not bother playing at it.
Comes around the wicket and angles it on off, Bishoo defends it with authority.
Just short of a length on off, Brathwaite blocks it off the back foot.
Sprays it on the pads, Brathwaite flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Back of a length around off, Kraigg moves back and across to block it.
Angles it into the batsman. DB tucks it towards mid on for a run.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on a length on the stumps. Bishoo covers the line and defends it.
Bangs it in on a length on middle, Bishoo defends it watchfully.
A message has been sent out by the Windies coach Stuart Law for the two batsmen in. Not sure what... Maybe, telling the nightwatchman to take maximum strike.
Good length around off, straightens a touch. KB is beaten as he tries to defend.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A tad shorter on off, Brathwaite gets it off the outer half down to third man for a couple. That was very well played by Brathwaite, he got over the bounce and did well to keep it down.
That has cut him into two! Wow! Lands it on a full length around off, nips back into the batsman sharply and goes through Brathwaite to the keeper. Lovely stuff from Anderson.
Good length on off, not a lot of swing there. Kraigg covers the line and defends it.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite camps back and defends it.
Shorter in length on middle, Bishoo defends it off the back foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bishoo is not interested in playing that one.
Length ball outside off, Bishoo shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite taps it in front of covers and takes a run to get the nightwatchman on strike.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A big away swinger outside off, Bishoo is in no mood to play at it.
Length ball on middle, Bishoo defends it off the back foot.
Devendra Bishoo, the nightwatchman comes out to bat with around 18 minutes left in the day.

OUT! 150th Test catch for Alastair Cook! Anderson gets his man. This was coming, wasn't it? Lands it on a length around middle, angling away from the batsman. Powell tries to defend it with a hesitant front foot movement but gets an outside edge to first slip. Cook cups it with ease. Jimmy raises his arms in celebration. 493rd Test victim for him!
Bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty. Powell does not opt to play at it.
Good length on off, angling away. Powell lets it be.
Angles it onto the pads, Brathwaite misses the flick and is struck high on the pads.
Bowls it on a length around off, Powell taps it in front of covers for a run.
JAFFA! Great seam positioning, lovely length. This is very good from Broad. Fuller on off, swinging away. Powell plays a loose shot and gets beaten. That could have easily taken the outside edge.
Lands it on a length outside off, Powell lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length on off, Powell defends it off the back foot.

EDGY FOUR! Even after having four slips and one gully in there it goes through. Fuller ball outside off, Powell goes for the drive away from the body but gets an outside edge through the gap for a boundary. He gets off the mark after 12 balls.
Good length outside off, Brathwaite is in no mood to play at it.
Lands it on a length around off, Kraigg defends it off the front foot.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Goes fuller this time on off, KB drives it straight back to the bowler who does well to get down and stop it.
Shapes it away from the batsman on a length around off, Kraigg defends it off the back foot.
Goes for the inswinger from outside off, Brathwaite tucks it to mid-wicket.
Just ahead of a length outside off, wide enough for the batsman to not play at it. Harmless over!
Again in that fourth stump channel. Powell watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Shorter outside off, wanting Powell to poke at it but he resists and does not flirt with it.
Similar length and line. Powell points his bat skywards and lets it through to the keeper.
Good pace there! Good length outside off, Powell lets it be.
Broad comes charging in and lands it on a length outside off, Powell opts not to play at it.
Shorter in length on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on middle, Kraigg tucks it to mid-wicket.
Bowls it outside off, Brathwaite lets it be.
Angles it into the pads, Brathwaite flicks it past square leg for a couple.
Back of a length on off, Kraigg guides it to point.
Anderson gets a little bit of movement in the air! A tad fuller outside off, swings away further. Brathwaite does not fiddle with it.
Similar length, closer to the off stump. Powell plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.
Good length outside off, straightens a touch. Powell first thinks of playing at it but then pulls his bat out of the way.
Bowls it on a length outside off from around the wicket. Powell watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
